Overview

Hódmezővásárhely is a city in Csongrád-Csanád with a population of 41,500. A historic market town on the Great Plain, known for its agricultural heritage, the Tornyai János Museum, and the traditional Hungarian horse shows. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
